name: reminder-clock
short_description: Web-based digital clock application with customizable time-based reminders for medication, meals, and daily tasks.
long_description: Reminder Clock is a progressive web application that displays a prominent digital clock interface alongside a comprehensive reminder system. Users can create, edit, and delete time-based reminders with customizable properties including message text, duration, visual icons (pill, food, sleep), color highlighting, and flashing animations. The application stores reminders locally using browser localStorage and automatically displays alerts at scheduled times with visual effects and optional sound support. Additional features include randomly-displayed comfort messages for emotional support, automatic day/night wallpaper transitions every 15 minutes, and a hidden settings dashboard accessible via five-click interaction. Designed with accessibility in mind, it supports both regular browser use and dedicated kiosk mode for display on tablets or devices used by elderly individuals or anyone requiring reliable daily task reminders.

modules.description: Main application logic with clock display updates, reminder checking, wallpaper rotation, comfort messages, and event handling.
Interactive reminder management with create, read, update, delete operations via modal forms and localStorage persistence.
Semantic HTML structure including clock display, reminder alert container, settings button, dashboard overlay, and form modal for reminder configuration.
Complete styling with responsive layout, custom fonts, animations (wallpaper fade, flashing borders, fade-in comfort messages), and dark overlay UI.
Bash script to serve static files via Python http.server on port 9999 with automatic restart on failure.
Bash script to launch Chromium browser in kiosk mode for dedicated display use with auto-respawn capability.
Directory of SVG reminder icons: pill (medication), food (meals), sleep (rest), plus application icon.png.
Background images directory with day and night themed JPG files that rotate based on time of day.
Custom font files including Digital-7 (monospace and regular) for clock display, Harmony for headers, and Adelia for comfort messages.
